messages:
elaine-support: Incoming customer report — streaming response is arriving as a partial JSON blob and the client throws "Unexpected end of JSON input". Customer says it only happens on longer responses and when they sit behind our proxy. Sample they pasted: ``{\n  "id": "resp_123",\n  "choices": [ { "text": "{\"user\":\"hi\"}, { "text": "{\"user\":\"ok\"} ]\n`` — you can see the inner JSON ends mid-stream.
sam-engineer: Can you paste the full request headers and the x-request-id? Also did they use SSE or chunked HTTP? Any client SDK info?
elaine-support: They say SSE with event stream, custom proxy (nginx) in front. x-request-id: req-17782-az9. SDK: custom fetch in node 18. Customer notes that if they disable proxy (direct to us) issue disappears.
mike-ml: Tagging eng-runtime — this smells like chunk boundary splitting around keepalive/newline framing. Some proxies insert keepalive bytes which can split the JSON token mid-token.
ci-bot: deploybot: finished deploy of rtm-fix-keepalive 2026-01-12 03:12 UTC
sam-engineer: Repro idea: run their proxy in front of a tiny SSE server that streams a valid JSON progressively and simulate keepalive padding. If keepalive inserts \r\n sequences mid-token it'll break streaming JSON consumers that buffer by newline.
elaine-support: Customer provided a minimal repro curl they ran: ``curl -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" https://api.redwood.inference/v1/stream?model=test\n`` They attached a network trace showing packet split between bytes 1024/1025.
jdoe-customer: (in thread) Confirming — direct connection works every time, with our nginx in front we see ~1/30 responses cut off. We can share nginx conf privately.
mike-ml: Can you ask them to try setting `proxy_set_header Connection ""; proxy_http_version 1.1; chunked_transfer_encoding on;` in nginx? Alternatively set `proxy_buffering off;` and `proxy_busy_buffers_size 256k;` — quick try to see if buffering/flush policy is culprit.
sam-engineer: Also request we capture our backend logs for req-17782-az9: need the streaming start/finish and any client disconnect events. If our runtime reports a client RST at the same time, that could be the root cause.
elaine-support: Pulled logs: runtime shows stream started at 2026-02-08T22:15:12Z and closed at 22:15:15Z with status = client_disconnect. Downstream nginx shows keepalive timeout at 22:15:15 exactly.
mike-ml: That aligns. Hypothesis: proxy is tearing the connection during slow token emission, causing the SSE to stop mid-JSON. Two mitigation paths:
 - short-term: add retry/auto-reassemble on client side for incomplete JSON event payloads (not ideal but quick)
 - platform-side: add a final sentinel chunk that closes JSON safely even if connection drops (risky for streaming semantics)
 - infra-side: recommend proxy settings to keep connection open and avoid mid-token flush (preferred)
sam-engineer: For triage, can we create a small repro server internally that emits a 2.5k JSON payload in SSE, then have an nginx proxy with default settings in front and run load to trigger keepalive? If we can reproduce, we'd either harden runtime to set more aggressive TCP keepalive or emit explicit SSE event boundaries that stand alone per token.
riley-oncall: Adding to eng-oncall board and assigning to eng-runtime-1. I'll create incident-# oncall-17782 and link ticket.
elaine-support: Customer sent nginx conf privately and allowed us to run tests from their environment. They've also given permission to try a quick nginx tweak. They prefer platform fix though — they can't touch all their proxies in prod easily.
sam-engineer: Ok next steps I propose:
 1) run internal repro with their nginx conf (priority today)
 2) if repro, test `proxy_buffering off` and `proxy_http_version 1.1` to confirm
 3) consider a runtime change: emit an extra newline-delimited SSE event that contains a small checksum every ~4k bytes so partial consumers can detect incomplete streams. Pros/cons in docory.
mike-ml: I'll sketch a short experiment script (node) that streams a nested JSON progressively and intentionally yields mid-token. Will post gist.
elaine-support: Customer is OK with testing. I've scheduled a short window 2pm PT to run tests with them. Also asked them to capture client console errors — they see `SyntaxError: Unexpected end of JSON input` from their JSON.parse.
jdoe-customer: Appreciate the quick turnaround. We'll be available 2pm PT. Please ping me here before starting.
sam-engineer: Thanks all — assigning to eng-runtime and reccing doc in support KB about proxies and SSE (will draft). Marking high priority since it affects structured-output customers using JSON mode over streaming.
ci-bot: supportbot: incident-17782 created and assigned to eng-runtime-rotation
riley-oncall: Noted. If we can reproduce, we'll decide on platform vs mitigation. Keep me posted.
elaine-support: Follow-up: captured tcpdump from their side shows TCP FIN from nginx to client while upstream still sending. Pointing to proxy idle/keepalive policy. I'll upload capture to ticket.
sam-engineer: Good. If proxy is the only culprit we'll add KB and guidance to avoid mid-token closes; otherwise we'll plan for runtime-resilience enhancements. Closing loop after repro window.
